name: Andariel APT Spreading TigerRat and TigerDownloader Via Phishing
description: Andariel group is a state-sponsored threat actor. It is a subgroup of the Lazarus cybercrime group, considered one of the most sophisticated North Korean threat actors to which threat researchers have attributed many attacks from 2009 to 2021. The Andariel group is mostly targeting South Korean entities focusing mainly on financial gain and cyber espionage. This group has been using both spearphishing and compromised websites, along with a custom downloader (TigerDownloader) and remote access trojan (TigerRAT) as their initial attack vector in recent financial and cyberespionage campaigns. TigerRat were distribute through spearphishing attachment and compromised website that will execute the malicious code after execution.  Coverage is in place for Symantec's email security products. TigerDownloader were being use to download the TigerRat. It then will communicate with C&C for further malicious command.
